name: Czechia

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C), adult
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.applies: all visa-required nationalities (unless facilitation agreement applies)
fees.notes: Payable at application; not refunded on refusal. Children 6-11: EUR 45; children under 6 free. Payable in EUR or local-currency equivalent. Czechia is a Schengen member; this is the common Schengen fee.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (Type A)
fees.notes: Same fee schedule as Type C Schengen visa.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C) - business purpose
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Business travel uses the same Schengen Type C visa and fee; there is no separate business visa category.

reciprocity_variations.note: Reduced fee under EU Visa Facilitation Agreements. Ukraine express processing option: EUR 70. (Most of these nationalities are in practice visa-exempt for short stays with biometric passports; the reduced fee applies where a visa is still required.)

vfs.note: VFS Global service charge in India is INR 2,220 (incl. GST), non-refundable, paid at appointment booking. Service fees vary by country/centre; Czechia outsources short-stay visa intake to VFS Global in many countries.

free_visa_notes: No e-visa, visa on arrival, or eTA exists for Czechia. Schengen visa fee waived for: children under 6, family members of EU/EEA citizens, school pupils/students and accompanying teachers on study trips, researchers, and representatives of non-profit youth organisations (aged 25 or under) attending events. Certain long-term (Type D) visas are free for citizens of Japan, South Africa and Turkey. Note: from late 2026 the EU ETIAS travel authorisation (EUR 20) will apply to visa-exempt travellers across Schengen, but it is an EU-wide fee, not a Czech fee.
